description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ClaimDaoAttachmentTest' for testing the 'ClaimDao' class functions related to claim attachments within the OrangeHRM system. It includes test methods for retrieving, counting, listing, saving, and deleting claim attachments, as well as testing the retrieval of attachment files. The class uses multiple traits for authentication, ORM, and date-time helpers, and sets up test data fixtures.
external_methods:
OrangeHRM
iem	est	ests ootstrap ootstrap

classes.name: ClaimDaoAttachmentTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ClaimDao's attachment-related functionalities in the OrangeHRM Claim plugin.

methods.name: testGetPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a partial claim attachment by request ID and attachment ID, verifying attachment ID and filename.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of claim attachments based on a search filter, verifying the count.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Tests listing claim attachments based on a search filter, verifying the count and filenames of attachments.

methods.name: testGetNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Tests generating the next available attachment ID for a specific request.

methods.name: testSaveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a new claim attachment and verifying its persistence.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of claim attachments and checks that the deleted attachment no longer exists.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by instantiating ClaimDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Tests retrieving an attachment file's properties and content for a specific attachment. Also verifies handling of a non-existent attachment request.
